product: Aircove Customer Portal — customer-experience Core Auth
note: This page is deliberately outside manifest.json and scenarios.json, exactly as the wave-18 login page is: it has no component factory, no route in router.js, no action id and no fixture, so it cannot have a manifest component entry or a scenarios.routes[] entry without inventing contracts the SPA does not own. This file is its coverage document. The accepted manifest.json and scenarios.json are unchanged by wave 19.
routeAttribute: auth.2fa (data-route on .auth-page — a presentation id, not a portal route; the portal never navigates here, core-auth serves it)

fields: code (text, inputmode=numeric, autocomplete=one-time-code, required, no autofocus)
form.submit: native form navigation. No fetch, no scripted submit, no loading state, no disabled state.
form.elementOrder: hidden CSRF → setup block → verify notice → label → input → accessible hint → assertive error → submit

states.presents: enrollment explanation, QR image from the core-auth data URL, setup key as an accessible manual fallback, one code field, one verify action
the same enrollment content, unchanged, plus one localized assertive error below the code field; resubmission through the same form
states.guarantees: CMS neither stores, regenerates, defaults nor re-renders the QR or the key — both are still the substituted runtime values, because the enrollment block lives inside the form and nothing scripted touches it

states.presents: already-enrolled notice, one code field, one verify action
states.absent: QR image, setup key, assertive region — the enrollment block occupies no layout and exposes no value

states.presents: verification context kept, one localized assertive invalid-code message, resubmission through the same form
states.guarantees: the message claims nothing beyond the supplied copy — no reason, no attempt count, no lockout hint

impossibleStates: There is no state in which both the enrollment block and the verify notice are shown, and none in which neither is: core-auth drives SETUP_DISPLAY and VERIFY_NOTICE_DISPLAY as opposites. The page does not enforce that — it has no state of its own — and renders acceptably if a runtime ever sends both.
notInThisBrief: reveal or copy control for the key

themes.mechanism: server-rendered data-theme + data-mode on <html>, the accepted declarative contract
themes.layout: identical for every theme — only the token pack changes. No tenant-specific rule exists in styles/core-auth-2fa.css.

validation.oneMarkedForm: exactly one <form>, marked data-core-auth-2fa; no other form element in the document
validation.fieldNames: code (unrenamed) + the hidden {{CSRF_PARAMETER_NAME}} input; method=post preserved
validation.noJavaScript: the transfer source contains no <script> tag and no event attribute. Visibility is the three inline display placeholders only — no class toggle, no data-state switch, no scripted state. Removing every script from the environment changes nothing.
validation.placeholdersPreserved: 8 referenced placeholders appear verbatim, once each where the contract puts them; no CMS parameter, default, fixture, log, analytics attribute or JS variable shadows any of them
validation.noThirdParty: no script, style, font, icon set, QR generator, telemetry or image from another origin. The QR src is the core-auth data URL; the only other asset references are the seven relative stylesheets.
validation.accessibility: explicit visible label for the code field; aria-describedby names the hint and the assertive region; one role=alert region on the page; heading order h1 (card) → h2 (pitch); no autofocus; visible focus from the accepted 2px accent outline; the setup key is selectable wrapping text, read in order after its own label
validation.responsive: container queries on .auth-page at the accepted thresholds (<=900 one column, form first; <=560 compact). Evidence at 1440 / 1180 / 768 / 390 in light and dark, plus 720 for 1440-at-200%-zoom and 920 / 390 for RTL.
validation.rtl: mirrors entirely through logical properties — no dir-specific rule exists. Evidence: 2fa-setup-ready-920-rtl-dark (two-column desktop, card left / pitch right) and 2fa-verify-error-390-rtl-light.
validation.motion: no animation and no transition is declared for this page, so reduced-motion behavior is unchanged
